templates.name: Annual Performance Review
templates.description: Standard year-end review with accomplishments, goals, and development focus.

questions.label: What were your key accomplishments this period?
Which goals did you not meet, and why?
How did you collaborate across teams?
What skills would you like to develop next?

templates.name: New Hire Check-In
templates.description: Early onboarding conversation to support new employees in their first weeks.

questions.label: How are you settling into your role and team?
What tools, training, or resources do you need right now?
What questions do you have about role expectations or company culture?
What would make your first month more successful?

templates.name: 90 Days at Work
templates.description: Structured check-in at the 90-day mark to review progress, goals, and support needs.

questions.label: What are your key accomplishments in your first 90 days?
Which onboarding goals are on track, and which need adjustment?
What skills or knowledge would help you perform at the next level?
How effective is collaboration with your manager and teammates?
What support do you need for the next phase of your role?
